body:
## What's Changed
* Consolidate desktop Keychain credentials and fix agent build dependencies by @FelipeBarrosCode in https://github.com/FelipeBarrosCode/no_land/pull/268
* Dev by @FelipeBarrosCode in https://github.com/FelipeBarrosCode/no_land/pull/269
* Add local spend tracking with monthly budget, alerts, and auto-stop by @maxdp66 in https://github.com/FelipeBarrosCode/no_land/pull/267
* Fix Linux remote-agent checksums and missing Windows resources by @FelipeBarrosCode in https://github.com/FelipeBarrosCode/no_land/pull/270
* Harden budget stop authorization, backup safety, and alert delivery by @FelipeBarrosCode in https://github.com/FelipeBarrosCode/no_land/pull/271

* Windows open ssh by @FelipeBarrosCode in https://github.com/FelipeBarrosCode/no_land/pull/273

* fix(sunshine): verify auth and guard credential repair by @FelipeBarrosCode in https://github.com/FelipeBarrosCode/no_land/pull/276
* fix(ci): repair resource checks and dependency security gates by @FelipeBarrosCode in https://github.com/FelipeBarrosCode/no_land/pull/277
* release: promote tested dev fixes to production by @FelipeBarrosCode in https://github.com/FelipeBarrosCode/no_land/pull/278
* fix(ci): separate release tests from packaging-only resources by @FelipeBarrosCode in https://github.com/FelipeBarrosCode/no_land/pull/279
* fix(release): complete Windows OpenSSH runtime and unique bundle resources by @FelipeBarrosCode in https://github.com/FelipeBarrosCode/no_land/pull/281
* fix(ci): repair release verification and nightly locale secret scan by @FelipeBarrosCode in https://github.com/FelipeBarrosCode/no_land/pull/282
* fix(release): fresh Windows signing dependencies and bounded Apple network retries by @FelipeBarrosCode in https://github.com/FelipeBarrosCode/no_land/pull/283

## New Contributors
* @maxdp66 made their first contribution in https://github.com/FelipeBarrosCode/no_land/pull/267
